text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Defeating all these enemies so easily... You're as fanatical as a demon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなにもたくさんの
敵を倒すなんて、
鬼がかってますね！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text:
But I can't let you outdo me.
I too am a demon. And I will crush our enemies!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レムも負けていられません。
これでも鬼族の端くれ、
敵を粉砕してみせます！
